security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://* http://*; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop client for your self-hosted Budget Planner server
bundle.longDescription: Tauri v2 client for the Budget Planner web app. The app contains NO backend: on first launch it asks for the server address, verifies the /.well-known/budget-planner discovery endpoint, and remembers it. Designed to work over a home LAN, Tailscale, or HTTPS reverse proxy.
